title: Thanks and purchase experience mentions
summary: This topic mostly contains brief thank-you notes or isolated appreciative remarks, with a few clear positives about ownership-related benefits and purchase value rather than a single coherent vehicle issue.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention the monitoring app and security helping with insurance value, and a mandatory care agreement contributing to a solid professional-use package.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews are mostly short thank-you messages or isolated compliments about delivery, brand purchase satisfaction, and the overhead view without enough detail for a clear sentiment classification.

limitations: Most examples are short thank-you phrases or acknowledgments with too little context to determine a specific product sentiment.
The cluster mixes ownership benefits, dealership delivery praise, purchase satisfaction, and a parking-camera usability comment rather than one tightly focused topic.
